name: I-880/I-80 Express Lanes START Program
description: At least 50% off I-880/I-80 express lane tolls for income-eligible Bay Area drivers
fullDescription: Express Lanes START is an MTC/Bay Area Infrastructure Financing Authority trial program that gives income-eligible Bay Area drivers at least 50% off tolls on the I-880 and I-80 Express Lanes.
whatTheyOffer:
- At least 50% off all tolled trips
- Available on I-880 Express Lanes
- Available on I-80 Express Lanes (not valid on other Bay Area express lanes)
- Helps lower-income commuters access faster travel times
- Works with FasTrak Flex toll tag
howToGetIt:
1. Must live in the nine-county Bay Area with gross household income at or below 200% of federal poverty level
2. Apply online at expresslanesstart.org (mail or fax applications also accepted)
3. Provide proof of income and residency
4. Use a FasTrak Flex toll tag if approved
5. Discount automatically applied when using the covered express lanes
keywords: express lanes, START, I-880, I-80, toll discount, FasTrak, low-income, Alameda County, HOV, carpool
